description: Leyfall: a magic overhaul for Minecraft 26.3 (Fabric) - seven schools, 112 spells, a settlement, research and a story with three endings. English and Ukrainian.

mods.name: Leyfall
mods.description: The last student of a dead empire: rebuild a settlement of its heirs, whose people forge and sing the keys of your initiation, while the Hollow offers a shorter way. Seven schools of magic, ley lines, research and a story with three endings.
